summary: Shell plc filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing a PDMR shareholding notification under EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation. President of Trading and Supply Andrew Smith disposed of 33,000 ordinary shares (ISIN GB00BP6MXD84) at EUR 48.622065 per share on October 30, 2026, on the Amsterdam exchange, for total proceeds of EUR 1,604,528.15. No board recommendation, advisor, strategic action, or deal structure is involved; this is a standard insiders' transaction disclosure incorporated by reference into existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. No event to trade; monitor only for cumulative insider selling signals.
